summary: Xos, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment offering of 1,090,910 common shares at $5.50 per share, representing a ~26% discount to the June 3 close of $7.46. The offering aims to raise ~$6.0M gross ($5.61M net after 6.5% placement agent fee). Roth Capital Partners is the sole placement agent on a reasonable best-efforts basis. The offering is conducted under a shelf registration (S-3), with an overhang limit per General Instruction I.B.6. Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. No special-situation event like a tender, going-private, or restructuring is present. Risk-arb focus: watch for Nasdaq compliance and shareholder dilution impact.
